pairs.question: Ne propter pabulum solueritis opus dei. Quod opus?
pairs.answer: Bonum est carnem non edere et uinum non potare.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-question. Kept the preceding sentence 'Ne propter pabulum solueritis opus dei' as setup so that 'Quod opus?' ('What work?') has its referent. Dropped the framing speech tag 'inquit' from the setup. The answer is the Pauline citation defining the opus dei; dropped the framing introduction 'De quo ait :' that narrates the citing, and normalized capitalization of the first word. Stopped at the first full stop after 'potare'.
